features.name: log_p3_normalized
features.description: Log-transformed and approximately standardized version of the highly skewed P3 feature.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the impact of extreme outliers in P3, providing a smooth, normalized feature that helps linear SVM establish a stable margin.

features.name: p11p3_p16p2_ratio
features.description: Ratio between P11p3 and P16p2, with a small constant added to the denominator to prevent division by zero.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the relative proportion between two key P-series features, allowing the linear model to leverage their interaction directly.

features.name: h15p1_centered
features.expected_model_benefit: Centering features helps linear SVM converge faster and improves the interpretability of the learned weights.

features.name: p6p4_p19p2_sum
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a simple linear projection of two related features, reducing dimensionality and providing a stronger combined signal.

features.name: h40p4_h5p2_diff
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights the divergence between two H-series metrics, which can be a strong linear separator.

features.name: p19p2_sqrt
features.expected_model_benefit: Spreads out values near zero for this right-skewed feature, making the distribution more linear-friendly.

features.name: composite_p_score
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a stable, weighted composite score that smooths out individual feature noise.

features.name: h15p1_h40p4_interaction
features.description: Multiplicative interaction between scaled H15p1 and H40p4.
features.expected_model_benefit: Explicitly provides a non-linear interaction term to the linear SVM, expanding its representational capacity.

features.name: p3_extreme_outlier
features.description: Binary indicator for extreme values in P3, using the training standard deviation as a threshold.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear model to assign a specific weight offset for extreme outliers, preventing them from skewing the main continuous weight.

features.name: housing_density_judgment
features.description: Semantic assessment of housing density based on H15p1 and H40p4, providing a continuous score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Translates raw housing metrics into a linear-friendly continuous severity measure.

features.name: property_value_tier
features.description: Semantic categorization of property value into tiers based on P3 and P11p3.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides an ordinal scale that linear SVM can use to weight different property value segments monotonically.

features.name: demographic_risk_index
features.description: Semantic judgment of demographic risk factors based on P6p4, P19p2, and H5p2.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines multiple demographic indicators into a single weighted composite score, reducing feature space and improving margin separation.
